decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Email from Katy Davis, Received 7 February 2012, A1677-1231-P21, A1677-1232-P21, BWL-MS-001-P2, BWL-MS-002-P2, Received 14 December 2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the premises restored to their former condition on or before the 14 August 2014 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The office floor space (B1) contained within this proposal hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the marketing suite and associated company usage and shall not be used for any other purpose.
description: Use of ground floor of the west wing for two show flats, B1 offices with ancillary areas,  use of the gallery and film liaison unit as a marketing suite, all for a temporary period of two years
